title: Filter Controller mechanical robustness QA
purpose: Run the non-visual robustness checks after the field-source foundation and patch objective failures before handing visual QA to Guilherme.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-046 is complete and the Filter Controller has dynamic field bindings plus Toolkit CPT field-source support.
exit_condition: The plugin has a reproducible mechanical robustness harness, all mechanical checks pass, and remaining visual/editor checks are explicitly assigned to Guilherme.
acceptance_criteria: The harness can be rerun through WP-CLI without mutating persistent CPT or preset state.
Mechanical checks for style cadence, field binding, dynamic tags, resolver semantics, range containment rules, and sort behavior pass.
Visual/editor-heavy checks are not falsely marked as passed without Guilherme QA.
Objective failures found by the harness are fixed or converted into explicit backlog.
